stages.0: Reserved lot outline composed by the block renderer; no building image.
stages.1: One-cell separate fence and south gate around the reserved footprint.
stages.2: Same fence and foundation with compact crane, cabin and materials composed inside the footprint.
stages.3: About half assembled: full unchanged physical lot and interior plane, unfinished structural walls and room partitions, no roof, internal material piles.

overrides: The user's compact-city redesign supersedes the legacy 18x14 lot, 8x16 door, shallow roof and stage-3 silhouette-height ratio. Assembly progress is semantic: removing a roof must not shrink the physical footprint or projected interior depth.
normalization: Draft stage5 uses uniform nearest-neighbour scale, hard alpha and a bounded palette. Future stages4/3 must use this same finished-source frame; no axis stretching, per-stage recentering or architectural repair.
